requests_without_a_tool_entry: E-1: SCR-15-desktop-whatsapp, SCR-15-mobile-whatsapp, SCR-15-desktop-email and SCR-15-mobile-email are rendered by the backend alert job (T-ALERTS / JOB-ALERTS), not the frontend. F-12 owns only their targets: Review now -> /work/<work_id>, alert settings -> /settings/alerts.
E-3: Save settings is drawn as a link and built as a button (it submits). The tool matches it and notes the role difference; no entry needed.

E-4: the phone back links "← Home" and "← Notifications" cannot sit inside the frame's phone bar (D-08). Under the bar on their own line they pushed every row down (SCR-15-mobile visual 76.2), so they sit at the right, level with the heading, as F-10's back link does under D-19, until the frame gets its back-link slot (D-13). The tool reports them as moved (not missing); visual 91.8 / 97.0.
E-5: STATES-desktop and STATES-mobile are checked element by element for the SCR-15 cards (empty, loading, error) in unit and e2e tests and by the reviewer's side-by-side, not by a whole-board score.
